saw_lines: Most home fitness buyers compare folding space, price and warranty, then wait for a deal before committing.
So the deal has to sit in the first line, or the buyer leaves to compare prices elsewhere.
Your site offers percent off on padel rackets, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it. Open three new ads with that percent off in line one and print it on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers percent off on padel rackets, yet 0 of 22 copy ads mention it, so buyers have no reason to click. Open three new ads with that percent off in line one and print it on the creative.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer comparing padel rackets has nothing to trust. Put your 4.6 rating on the creative of your 7 longest running ads, then add a review count to the next batch.
Three of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a buyer who clicks has to search again. Point each to the product it shows, the way your Reebok i-Run 5.0 See details ads already do.
Your 22 copy ads use 15 different openings and the biggest leads only 3 ads, so no story gets enough runs to prove itself. Build the next batch from the two best stories, such as the adidas home gym.
